text: Chair Myers has submitted an administrative inquiry under Section 40 of the By-law to Govern Board Proceedings for the June 3 2026, meeting of the Toronto Commission Board (TTC) to clarify the ridership of the Community Bus program, the cost of continuing to provide the Community Bus service, and the per ride subsidy for offering the service. Under the By-law to Govern Board Proceedings, the TTC Board can receive or refer an Administrative Inquiry to the appropriate TTC official or department.
The TTC Board, on June 3, 2026, received Administrative Inquiry TTC15.1 from Chair Jamaal Myers, on Community Bus Routes, and Answer from the Chief Transportation Officer for information.
